critical_code_review_comments: Fix verified correct: useAnswerState (onboarding.tsx:32-45) initializes from getAnswer(key) and mirrors every set into setAnswer(key); all ~20 answer fields (incl. contacts array and selectedPlan) use it (onboarding.tsx:593-615). resetOnboardingProgress (onboarding-progress.ts:18) resets step AND clearOnboardingAnswers - invoked by profile.tsx Reset Journey (504), account deletion (471) and login.tsx fresh-start paths.

setAnswer is called inside the setV updater (side effect in updater, onboarding.tsx:38-42) - idempotent write so harmless even under StrictMode double-invoke, but same anti-pattern family as flagged in iter17/19.

Known limitation (intended per handoff): answer cache is module-level in-memory; a full page reload wipes it even though lastOnboardingScreen and hera_onboarded persist elsewhere. Matches stated design.
Reset Journey on a signed-in user also calls POST /api/account/reset - succeeded silently; delivered@resend.dev account intact (journey data wiped only, as designed).

rca_of_issue: ITERATION_19 ISSUE NOW RESOLVED. Previous RCA: answers were component-local useState lost when router.replace('/subscription') unmounted onboarding.
